name: link
title: Link
summary: A link in running text or on its own.
description: A link in running text ("read the deploy log"), or one on its own ("View all deploys"). Inline links are always underlined, in a softer shade that takes the full colour on hover; standalone links are medium weight and underline on hover. Accent or neutral tone. external opens a new tab and says so: an arrow after the text and a visually hidden "(opens in a new tab)". Text links never scale; a press shifts the colour. Use it instead of a bare <a>; for a router's link component, give it the recipe's classes (link()).

anatomy.description: The anchor, with every attribute passed on (href, download, rel…). Wraps anywhere, so a pasted URL never overflows its column; its text keeps its own direction. 3px focus-ring radius on each line of a wrapped link.
With external: the arrow-up-right icon (aria-hidden, 0.85em, mirrored right-to-left) held to the last word, not underlined, followed by a visually hidden label ("(opens in a new tab)").

variant.description: inline: inside a sentence, always underlined (1px, 3px under the text, 40% of the link's colour; full colour on hover). standalone: a link on its own line or at the end of a card ("View all deploys"): medium weight, no line at rest, the line on hover; its hit area is 40px tall on coarse pointers.

tone.description: accent: accent-ink, the link in product text. neutral: ink with an ink-3 underline (the line is all that marks it), for quiet text (a field hint, a footnote, terms).

external.description: Opens in a new tab: target=_blank, rel="noopener noreferrer", the arrow marker and the hidden label. A rel or target you pass wins.

labels.description: { external: '(opens in a new tab)' }, the hidden text read after an external link.

slots.default: The link text (and an icon with data-slot="icon", which takes 1em).

keyboard: Tab reaches it; Enter follows it
notes: Inline links are underlined at rest: colour alone does not tell a link from text.
An external link says so to screen readers ("(opens in a new tab)", visually hidden) and to sight (the arrow).
Name the destination in the text ("read the deploy log"), not "click here".
No visited colour: product links are navigation, the same link looks the same every time.

motion: hover: colour and underline colour over duration.fast (a real pointer only)
press: the colour shifts at once (accent → accent; neutral → ink-2) and eases back over duration.fast on release; no scale (text links never scale)
focus: the global ring, never faded
